Index: docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
===================================================================
--- docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
+++ docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
@@ -148,6 +148,8 @@
 
 Learning ingestion has conservative application budgets independent of gamma:256KiB/1000 rows per statistics request;256-code-unit scope/item/cell components and2048-byte keys;512KiB,256 items and4096 total item-plus-slot counters per stored value. An over-cap batch is refused whole with413 and `applied:false`, before any counter save; no eviction, coarsening, remapping or retry is performed. Existing ineligible rows still count as skipped. Malformed/oversized existing state and owner mismatch return503 requiring recovery, without automatic reset. Save/reset acknowledgement failure invalidates cache; a reset-item publication failure after deletion returns503 without claiming rollback. The existing explicit reset remains available.
 
+Statistics exposures and credits require an explicit valid slot configuration (missing/invalid:400). A changed reward, objective (absent means `unit`) or `tauLearnMs` refuses with409 and `applied:false` before either item or slot counters, storage or alarms change. Estimator-only `n0`, `nMin` and lift clamps remain editable without discarding counts. Current outcome producers explicitly carry the resolved document's default configuration for unconfigured slots; the ring never infers one from stored history or silently replaces a malformed override. New snapshots publish `tauLearnMs`; live serving checks owner, reward, objective, horizon and estimator settings on fresh reads and cache hits. Missing legacy horizon or mismatch omits learned evidence without erasing the cached snapshot or overriding an explicit operator-frozen lift. Archived pure replay is unchanged. This is forward containment, not proof of clean legacy history, atomic configuration rollout, reward filtering, reset/rebuild, generation transition or money/attribution-policy reconciliation; old binaries and historical aggregates remain separate work.
+
 Snapshots contain only their named identity fields and estimates, not raw statistics/configuration. Prior documents are gated at4096 rows/256KiB before indexing/building; selected keys allow at most six components/2048 bytes, and actual item/key/ancestor expansion shares the256-item/4096-counter limits. Output is capped at2MiB before response/publication. This gate follows the existing configuration read/validation, so it is not a bound on raw KV parsing/import allocation. Existing multi-component-prior interpretation is unchanged. These are application budgets tested with synthetic bounded storage, not native provider-limit or sustained-capacity proof. Historical oversized-object reconstruction, old KV snapshots/completeness policy, vocabulary/estimator/generation policy and full W10 remain separate work.
 
 Decision-ring append/outcome requests are bounded at1MiB of actual UTF-8 JSON, with1000 append records and2048-byte decision/outcome/index IDs. The full stored ring-plus-index candidate is limited to1MiB and4096 index entries, preserving the existing200-record/7-day ring and90-day index age rules without new eviction or projection. Capacity overflow refuses the whole ring append before saving with413 and `applied:false`; this is ring-local, not rollback of concurrently accepted statistics exposures. Existing fan-out reports incomplete without retry. Malformed/oversized saved state returns503 without history or credits; explicit reset remains reachable and ambiguous save/reset acknowledgements force reload. Full decision records remain available, but rich payloads can reach the byte cap before200 records. These are synthetic-tested application budgets, not native-limit, sustained-capacity, complete-history or recovery guarantees.
